content.comment_body: Hello, I am working on a project where I need to connect a wireless thermal data logging device to the internet network. My idea is to use a [product_name] and connect it to a wireless adapter. [url] Is it possible to connect them on the same network? If not, could you suggest an alternative solution?
This should work. I have previously used a TP-Link WLAN Adapter for a similar setup.
Yes, you can use a TP-Link Nano Router for this purpose. I am aware that such routers have been used in some [company_name] [product_name] demonstration setups. Hope this information is helpful.

Multiple users confirm that this approach is workable, citing both their own experiences and references to demo setups. The conversation reflects a need for straightforward solutions and guidance for wireless networking with [company_name] hardware, with practical sharing of knowledge about effective third-party hardware solutions.
